inputKind: dropped image FILE (no pasteHTML path; ImageDialog file input + assessmentMediaApi gates)
harness: unit-level: uploadImageAsset gates (assessmentMediaApi.ts) + ImageDialog file flow (RichQuestionComposer.tsx); no TipTap handleDrop exists - dropped files hit ProseMirror default drop handling, NOT an upload

observedGates.typeGate: file.type must start with image/ else 'Only image files can be inserted here.'
observedGates.sizeGate: file.size > 10MB else 'Images must be 10 MB or smaller.' (11MB png rejected; 1MB png proceeds)
observedGates.checksumGate: SHA-256 via crypto.subtle required; null digest -> 'Secure browser cryptography is required for image uploads.'
observedGates.flow: checksum -> POST /v1/media/uploads (ownerKind assessment_question today; assessment_import reserved for ingestion, NOT wired) -> PUT bytes -> POST complete
observedGates.dialogPreview: local preview uses URL.createObjectURL + revoke-on-unmount; persisted node uses assetSource(assetId) (/api/v1/media/<id>) or https URL, never the object URL

files.pass1MB: png ~1MB -> proceeds to intent->PUT->complete; node attrs {src, assetId, alt REQUIRED, caption}
files.fail11MB: png 11MB -> rejected with size message before any network call

validatorOutcome: size-gate message surfaced in ImageDialog alert with Retry; staged node without alt -> sat.accessibility.alt.required (blocking)
